about: The timestamp authorities whose timestamps this site shows (docs/offline.md, 'Whose timestamp'). A token is shown only when the certificate that signed it is one of these, by the SHA-256 of its DER; the name shown is the name here. A token is shown only when its own time is within the certificate's notBefore and validUntil (its notBefore and notAfter). Copies of each certificate are in docs/tsa-pins/. Published with each release as /tsa-pins.json. To add one: node scripts/tsa-pin.mjs <address>, then check its source as the 'verified' lines below do.

pins.name: FreeTSA
pins.subject: CN=www.freetsa.org, OU=TSA, O=Free TSA
pins.verified: 20 Nov 2026: the PEM file's SHA-256 (8bfb0305…3467) is the one FreeTSA publishes for tsa.crt on freetsa.org; it chains to FreeTSA's root (docs/tsa-pins/freetsa-ca.pem, whose PEM SHA-256 2151b611…4438 is also as published) with openssl verify -purpose timestampsign. A real FreeTSA token from 15 Nov 2026, in a public repository, was signed by this certificate (found with scripts/tsa-signer.mjs, the site's own parser).

pins.name: DigiCert
pins.subject: CN=DigiCert SHA256 RSA4096 Timestamp Responder 2025 1, O=DigiCert, Inc.
pins.verified: 20 Nov 2026: the same bytes from two unrelated public copies of DigiCert tokens' chains; chains to DigiCert Trusted Root G4 in the operating system's trust store through DigiCert Trusted G4 TimeStamping RSA4096 SHA256 2025 CA1 (openssl verify -purpose timestampsign), extended key usage Time Stamping, critical.

pins.name: DigiCert
pins.subject: CN=DigiCert SHA256 RSA4096 Timestamp Responder 2026 1, O=DigiCert, Inc.
pins.verified: 20 Nov 2026: as for the 2025 responder: two unrelated public copies, byte-identical, chaining to DigiCert Trusted Root G4 in the operating system's trust store, Time Stamping only. A real DigiCert token from 15 Nov 2026, in a public repository, was signed by this certificate (found with scripts/tsa-signer.mjs, the site's own parser).
